Lane work: Revelio headcount/postings [24] and the March-2026 documentation cuts [26] corroborate the opex_pct path (headcount +12.5% vs revenue +29%); FUNDA's partner checks [25] (consumption attainment +30-35% 2Q26E, +25-30% 2H26E; Cortex Code ~3% of consumption) suggest Q3/Q4 FY27 nrr may be ~1 pt rich, a <5% revenue effect; no SNOW prediction market exists [31]. Fetch budget (6 pages) limited the alt-data depth: Reddit/forum snapshots, Google Trends and job-posting trackers were found in search but not read, so in-lane sources fall short of 60% of the list (the set's filings dominate). Valuation: peers DDOG/NET/MDB (non-GAAP consensus from StockAnalysis, calendarised to NTM) plus ESTC/TDC/DT from the run table; EV/sales median 7.83x, P/E 75.5x; exit multiples by the k=0.8 shrink (12.66x, 91.7x). drivers.derivation: Identity (per Kilian's spec): product revenue(q) = product revenue(same quarter a year earlier) x nrr + new_cust. FY29 123->120%, FY30 119->117%: the fade the company showed as the base grew (131% Q4 FY24 -> 124% Q1 FY26 [11,1]) plus Iceberg tables (storage and some compute outside Snowflake, 10-Q risk factor [7]), Databricks warehousing ($1.5B, >100% growth [23]) and price-performance cuts passed through.
